pages.title: About Kidlo
pages.excerpt: Thoughtful toys, dependable service, and clearer choices for families across Pakistan.
pages.content:
Kidlo is a Pakistan-based toy retailer helping families choose thoughtful, age-appropriate play without the uncertainty of an endless marketplace. Since 2019, we have served parents, gift-givers, schools, and businesses across the country.

Chosen with purpose

We assess play value, age suitability, build quality, and the clarity of every product before it reaches the catalogue.

Made for Pakistan

Prices are in rupees, local payment methods are supported, and our delivery team understands addresses across Pakistan.

Clear guidance

Honest age bands, stock status, dimensions, and practical descriptions help customers choose with confidence.

Human support

Our Lahore team assists with gifts, product questions, orders, returns, schools, and business purchases.

What you can expect

  • Cash on delivery, cards, EasyPaisa, and JazzCash at checkout.
  • Free standard delivery above PKR 2,000 and transparent fees below it.
  • Nationwide delivery, usually within 2–5 working days.
  • A practical 30-day return policy for eligible unused products.
Our purpose is simple: help every child discover something that invites imagination, movement, curiosity, or connection.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.excerpt: How a small Lahore catalogue grew into a nationwide destination for play.
pages.content:
Kidlo began in Lahore in 2019 with a small storeroom, a carefully selected range, and a WhatsApp catalogue. The goal was not to list every toy available; it was to make choosing the right one easier.

From conversations to a better store

Parents repeatedly asked for dependable age guidance, clear prices, reliable stock, and a delivery rider who would call before arriving. Those everyday concerns became the operating principles behind Kidlo.

2019 · The beginning

A small local catalogue focused on gifts and early-years play.

2021 · Beyond Lahore

Courier partnerships expanded delivery to families across Pakistan.

2023 · Smarter discovery

Age, interest, gender, and budget filters made the growing range easier to navigate.

Today · The same promise

Real guidance, responsive support, and products we can confidently dispatch.

What has not changed

We remain focused on practical service: accurate listings, fair offers, careful packing, and a real person to help when a birthday or school event cannot wait.

pages.title: Careers
pages.excerpt: Build a more thoughtful toy-shopping experience with the Kidlo team.
pages.content:
Kidlo brings together retail, e-commerce, customer care, buying, content, and fulfilment. We value thoughtful people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and understand that small service details matter to families.

Teams at Kidlo

Buying & catalogue

Product research, supplier coordination, quality checks, merchandising, and accurate listings.

Customer experience

Order support in Urdu and English across phone, WhatsApp, email, and social channels.

Operations

Inventory accuracy, careful packing, dispatch, courier coordination, and returns.

Digital & creative

E-commerce, campaigns, photography, content, analytics, and product experience.

How to apply

Send your preferred role, city, relevant experience, availability, and a CV or portfolio link through the form below. If there is a suitable opening, our team will contact you. Kidlo is an equal-opportunity employer and never charges an application fee.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.excerpt: A clear explanation of how Kidlo collects, uses, and protects personal information.
pages.content:
This policy explains what information Kidlo collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you when you browse, create an account, contact us, or place an order.

Last updated: 9 October 2026.

Information we collect

  • Identity and contact details such as name, email, phone number, and delivery address.
  • Order information including products, payment method, delivery status, returns, and support history.
  • Account credentials stored as a protected password hash; Kidlo cannot view your password.
  • Basic device, browser, and site-usage information used for security and service improvement.

How we use information

We use personal information to fulfil orders, process payments and refunds, provide support, prevent fraud, meet legal obligations, and improve our services. Marketing messages are sent only where you have requested them, and you may unsubscribe at any time.

Sharing and retention

Necessary details may be shared with payment providers, couriers, technology suppliers, and professional advisers working on our behalf. We do not sell personal information. Records are retained only for as long as reasonably required for service, accounting, dispute, and legal purposes.

Your choices

You may request access, correction, deletion, or marketing opt-out by emailing hello@kidlotoys.pk from the address associated with your account. Some transaction records may need to be retained where required by law.

Never send card numbers, PINs, passwords, or one-time codes to Kidlo by email, WhatsApp, or an inquiry form.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.excerpt: The terms that apply when browsing Kidlo or placing an order.
pages.content:
These terms govern your use of Kidlo and purchases made through the store. By placing an order, you confirm that the information supplied is accurate and that you are authorised to use the selected payment method.

Last updated: 9 October 2026.

Orders and pricing

Prices are shown in Pakistani rupees. Product availability, promotions, and delivery estimates may change. An order is accepted when Kidlo confirms it for fulfilment; we may cancel or adjust an order affected by a genuine pricing error, failed payment, unavailable stock, suspected fraud, or an unreachable delivery number.

Payments, delivery, and ownership

Available payment methods are displayed at checkout. Cash-on-delivery orders may require phone confirmation. Delivery dates are estimates and can be affected by courier capacity, weather, public holidays, security restrictions, or incomplete addresses. Responsibility for the parcel passes to the customer when delivery is recorded at the supplied address.

Products and safe use

Colours and packaging can vary slightly from images. Age labels, warnings, instructions, and adult-supervision guidance must be followed. Batteries and accessories are included only where the product description says so.

Returns and acceptable use

Eligible returns are handled under our Returns & Refunds policy. You may not misuse the site, attempt unauthorised access, copy protected material at scale, submit unlawful content, or use Kidlo for fraudulent transactions.

Contact

Questions about these terms may be sent to hello@kidlotoys.pk. Nothing in these terms removes rights that cannot legally be excluded under applicable Pakistani law.

Kidlo supplies selected toys to retailers, schools, event planners, corporate teams, and other registered organisations. Availability and trade pricing depend on product, quantity, destination, and lead time.

Events & gifting

Corporate buyers

Quotations, invoices, grouped packing, and planned delivery.

Trade terms

  • Prices exclude delivery unless the quotation states otherwise.

Use the form below with your business name, city, product interest, estimated quantities, and required date. Our team will respond with availability and next steps.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds
pages.excerpt: Eligibility, return steps, and refund timing explained clearly.
pages.content:
We want every purchase to arrive complete and as described. Eligible unused products may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery, while damaged, defective, or incorrect items should be reported as soon as possible.

Start a return

  1. Contact Kidlo with your order number and the item you want to return.
  2. For damage, defects, or an incorrect item, share clear photos or a short video of the product and packaging.
  3. Keep the item, accessories, manuals, labels, and original packaging together for collection.
  4. After inspection, we confirm replacement, store credit, or refund and the expected timing.

Eligibility

  • Change of mind: unused, unopened where sealed, complete, and in resalable packaging.
  • Faulty or incorrect: Kidlo arranges collection and covers reasonable return delivery.
  • Not eligible: used, damaged after delivery, incomplete, personalised, clearance marked final sale, or opened hygiene-sensitive baby items unless faulty.

Refund timing

Card and wallet refunds are returned to the original method where possible, usually within 5–7 working days after approval. Cash-on-delivery refunds are sent by verified bank transfer or mobile wallet. Your bank or provider may require additional processing time.

A damaged outer courier bag does not always mean the product is damaged. If it is safe, photograph the parcel before opening and retain all packaging until your case is resolved.

pages.title: FAQs
pages.excerpt: Practical answers about orders, products, payment, delivery, gifts, and returns.
pages.content:
Find quick answers about ordering, delivery, products, payments, gifts, and returns. For help with an existing purchase, include your order number when contacting us.

Where does Kidlo deliver?

We deliver across Pakistan through courier partners. Most orders arrive within 2–5 working days; remote destinations and high-volume periods may take longer.

Which payment methods are available?

Available options appear at checkout and may include cash on delivery, card, EasyPaisa, and JazzCash. Never share your PIN or one-time code with anyone claiming to be Kidlo.

How do I track an order?

Open Track My Order and enter the Kidlo order number plus the phone used at checkout. The demo order is KD1001 with 03001234567.

Can I change or cancel an order?

Contact us promptly. We can usually update an order before packing; after dispatch, a change may not be possible and courier or return charges can apply.

How should I choose an age?

Use the recommended age on the product page and consider the child's abilities and interests. For children under three, avoid products with small detachable parts and supervise all play.

Are batteries included?

Only when the product description specifically says they are included. We recommend having the stated battery type ready before gifting.

Can Kidlo wrap a gift?

Gift wrapping is complimentary on qualifying orders over PKR 3,000. Add the recipient message and any delivery instructions in the checkout notes.

What if an item arrives damaged?

Keep the item and packaging, take clear photos or a short video, and contact us with your order number. Eligible cases are replaced or refunded under our return policy.

Do you support schools and bulk orders?

Yes. Share the age group, quantities, budget, city, and required date through our Bulk Orders or Wholesale page for a tailored quotation.

pages.title: Shipping Info
pages.excerpt: Delivery charges, estimates, tracking, and important courier information.
pages.content:
Kidlo delivers throughout Pakistan using established courier partners. Most in-stock orders arrive within 2–5 working days after confirmation.

Standard delivery

Free on qualifying orders of PKR 2,000 or more; PKR 199 below the threshold.

Dispatch cut-off

Confirmed Lahore and Karachi orders placed before 2 PM may dispatch the same day.

Order tracking

Use your order number and checkout phone on the Track My Order page.

Courier contact

Keep your phone available; the rider may call for directions or delivery confirmation.

Delivery estimates

  • Lahore and Karachi: typically 1–3 working days.
  • Other major cities: typically 2–4 working days.
  • Remote areas: typically 3–6 working days where courier service is available.

Important information

Orders placed after the cut-off, on public holidays, or during major campaigns may dispatch the next working day. Weather, road closures, security restrictions, and courier capacity can affect estimates. Please provide a complete address, city, landmark, and reachable phone number.

Inspect the parcel for obvious damage or tampering before accepting it. If there is a concern, photograph the package and contact Kidlo promptly.

pages.title: Size & Age Guide
pages.excerpt: Choose safer, more engaging toys for every stage of childhood.
pages.content:
Age guidance is a starting point, not a measure of ability. Choose a toy that is safe for the youngest child who may access it, then consider interests, confidence, attention span, and the level of adult support available.

0–2 years

Sensory textures, soft toys, rattles, stacking, push-and-pull play. Avoid small parts, long cords, and accessible batteries.

3–5 years

Pretend play, large building pieces, first puzzles, art, movement, and simple cause-and-effect games.

6–8 years

Construction sets, beginner STEM, craft kits, outdoor games, RC toys, and rule-based family games.

9–11 years

Detailed builds, science kits, strategy games, creative projects, robotics, and skill-based outdoor play.

12–14 years

Advanced STEM, coding, hobby kits, complex strategy, model making, and supervised drones.

15+ years

Collector pieces, advanced projects, technical builds, social games, and specialist hobby products.

Size and fit

For ride-ons, sports equipment, costumes, and wearable accessories, check product dimensions rather than relying on age alone. Compare measurements with an item that currently fits and allow room for safe movement—not excessive growth.

Safety comes first

  • Follow the strictest age warning shown on the product or packaging.
  • Inspect toys regularly and remove damaged pieces, loose batteries, or broken cords.
  • Use helmets and protective equipment where recommended.
  • Supervise water, projectile, electrical, chemistry, ride-on, and drone play.

pages.title: Gift Cards
pages.excerpt: Give families the freedom to choose play they will genuinely enjoy.
pages.content:
A Kidlo gift card lets parents and children choose the toy that suits them. Digital cards are issued as a unique checkout code and can be sent to the purchaser or directly to the recipient.

Available values

PKR 1,000

A thoughtful contribution toward a favourite toy.

PKR 2,000

A flexible choice for birthdays and small celebrations.

PKR 5,000

Ideal for family gifting and milestone occasions.

Custom value

Ask our team about larger personal or corporate requirements.

How it works

  1. Submit the form with the value, recipient details, and preferred delivery date.
  2. Our team confirms payment and prepares the unique digital card.
  3. The recipient enters the code at checkout before completing payment.

Gift card terms

  • Valid for 12 months from issue unless the card states otherwise.
  • May be used toward products and standard delivery charges on Kidlo.
  • Not redeemable for cash and cannot be replaced after unauthorised sharing or use.
  • If the order exceeds the balance, the remaining amount is paid using an available checkout method.

pages.title: Bulk Orders
pages.excerpt: Planned toy sourcing for schools, celebrations, communities, and teams.
pages.content:
We help schools, organisations, event planners, and families source larger quantities without making every item identical. Tell us the audience and occasion; we can suggest an age-appropriate mix within your budget.

Popular requirements

Schools

Prizes, activity days, classroom kits, sports events, and learning resources.

Celebrations

Birthday favours, Eid gifts, mehndi activities, and family events.

Community events

Society events, charity distributions, recreation, and children's programmes.

Corporate gifting

Family days, employee gifts, branded notes, and grouped delivery.

What to include

  • Event date and delivery city.
  • Number of children and approximate age range.
  • Per-child or total budget.
  • Preferred categories, packaging, and any items to avoid.

Standard lead time is around four working days within Punjab and six working days for other provinces after approval and payment. Large, customised, or imported requirements may need longer.

blog_posts.title: Best STEM Toys for 8–12 Year Olds in 2025
blog_posts.excerpt: Discover our expert picks for science and coding toys that make learning irresistibly fun for school-age children.
blog_posts.content:
Between 8 and 12, children can follow a multi-step build and still want it to feel like a toy. That is the window where a coding robot or a junior lab earns its shelf space.

What we put in the cart

Start with one open-ended kit, not five boxed experiments. The Coding Robot Starter Kit teaches sequence without a screen. The Junior Science Lab is better if they already like "why does this fizz?".

Leave the instructions nearby for the first session, then let them repeat it wrong. The repeat is the lesson.
blog_posts.author: Kidlo Team

blog_posts.title: How to Choose Safe Toys for Toddlers: A Parent's Complete Guide
blog_posts.excerpt: Everything you need to know about toy safety certifications, age labels, and what to look out for.
blog_posts.content:
Read the age floor before the photos. For toddlers, reject toys with button batteries, long cords, and parts that fit through a toilet-paper tube.

A quick check

  • Edges are smooth and paint does not smell sharp.
  • Soft toys have embroidered eyes, not plastic ones that pull off.
  • The box names a real brand you can search.

Kidlo marks an age range on every product page. If a listing and a box disagree, trust the stricter age and message us — we will correct the page.
blog_posts.author: Dr. Ali Hussain
